purpose: Measure independently correct deliveries of an ordinary coding agent before introducing mandatory Proofline assurance.
reference_evidence: docs/BOUNDED-COMPARISON.md, prior completed six-task small comparison; separate non-reused tasks and scores.

assignment.worker_input: Only source.md and product/ seed; no oracle/variants/controls; deny network and evaluator/research/root paths.

independent_finite_controls.expected: reference and structurally different alternative pass; seeded material defect rejected

grader.criterion_source: literal expected outputs and invalid-input classifications authored from the original requests, independent of implementation algorithms
grader.execution: trusted local controls only; any later untrusted model candidate must run behind qualified native sandbox with evaluator inputs protected and network denied
grader.operator_author: same study author; no independent second human oracle author

outcomes.observed_correct: All frozen private behavioral/compatibility checks pass for the exact candidate under qualified independent evaluation.
outcomes.correct_delivery: Observed correct plus explicit completed handoff before deadline.
outcomes.false_acceptance: Completed handoff despite independently observed incorrect candidate.
outcomes.false_blocking: No completed handoff despite independently correct candidate.
outcomes.failed: Candidate produced, independently evaluated incorrect, no completed handoff.
outcomes.unavailable: Execution or grading cannot be observed reliably; never scored as correct or incorrect.
outcomes.not_executed: Assignment never dispatched; remains in assigned denominator.

stop_rules: Unqualified native isolation or readable grader/private answers
Task, base tree, source, oracle, runtime or budget changed after freeze
Evaluator positive/alternative/negative controls do not match
Unsafe worker reads, network, protected mutations, or sibling/root access
Unreconciled native worker or broken receipt
Operator changes scope or model; terminate with partial report, do not replace or retry assignments

accounting.denominator: All 6 declared ordinary-agent assignments, including failures and not-executed
accounting.observed_only: Rates and seconds/tokens per correct delivery remain null if no observed correct deliveries; always report executed/assigned separately
accounting.tokens: input, cached subset, output and unknown-usage dispatches; do not double-count cached or reasoning output
accounting.time: sum elapsed episode seconds across attempts plus separate study preparation/grader/operator time; missing time unknown
accounting.human: record actual manual actions and active human attention when observable; unknown otherwise
accounting.currency: unknown unless authoritative rates are frozen
accounting.post_declaration_changes: new versioned study only; no retroactive result edits

future_comparison: Use identical raw requests, starting bytes, private independent checks, budgets and host/model settings. Freeze arm ordering and runtime before dispatch; report all assignments including missing results. Comparisons do not establish superiority from a six-task sample.

qualifications.current_claim: Only six task fixtures, independent finite grader and controlled preparation are implemented; no ordinary-agent performance claim.
